sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L223-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A boy classmate has just done something wrong and is making amends by tidying a messy classroom table while a visually distinct recurring teacher guides him warmly.
Visual cast: boy classmate plus teacher with short gray-black tied-back hair, rectangular glasses, sage green cardigan, plain top, dark trousers; teacher must not look like protagonist mother.
Composition: centered cleanup action, fully visible people and table, safe margins.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor children's textbook illustration using L058 only as style reference.
Avoid: no text, numbers, labels, signs, writing on papers, logos, watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 男孩同學做錯事後，主角老師或主角媽媽溫和地引導他改過；畫面可以是男孩同學把弄亂的桌子重新整理好，表現做錯後願意改過。若使用老師，老師必須和主角媽媽視覺上不同。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.text: 褲子拿錯了，改天拿去還。
sentences.spokenText: 褲子拿錯了改天拿去還
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L223-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At home, protagonist little girl holds a plain pair of pants she accidentally brought home from school; protagonist mother gently reminds her to return it later.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl in pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt or school clothes, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; protagonist mother in white/beige blouse, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair.
Composition: centered girl, mother, wrong pants, school bag, folded plain school clothing; safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor children's family-life illustration; L058 style only, L154/L162 family continuity.
Avoid: no text, numbers, names, labels, tags, logos, writing on bag or clothing, watermark; no changing clothes.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩把別人的褲子拿回家了，在家中發現褲子拿錯，主角媽媽提醒她改天拿去學校還給同學。畫面要清楚呈現「拿錯褲子、之後要拿去還」的情境，可用主角小女孩拿著不屬於自己的褲子、旁邊有書包或校服提示學校來源；不可有姓名、文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L223-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In a simple school hallway after physical education class, two female classmates only, protagonist little girl and a clearly different female classmate, discover they accidentally took or wore each other's plain school uniform pieces and prepare to switch back later.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl with pink hair clip; second student is a girl with a different face and ponytail/yellow hair tie. Both fully dressed, no adults.
Composition: centered two girls, clothing mix-up clear, plain hallway and cubbies, safe margins.
Style: gentle watercolor children's school illustration; L058 style only.
Avoid: no changing process, exposed body, locker-room view, text, numbers, names, labels, badges, school emblem writing, posters, signs, logos, watermark.
sentences.imageNotes: 學校體育課結束後，兩位女同學角色：主角小女孩和女同學，在準備換回校服時發現彼此穿錯校服，需要快換回來。畫面必須是在學校或教室附近的安全換裝前後情境，只呈現發現穿錯與準備更正，不呈現更衣過程；兩位學生都必須是女同學，不要畫成男女同學互換。校服上不可有校名、文字、數字、徽章字樣或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸和主角小女孩在家中看著一個小玩具的電池盒，乾電池放錯方向，所以玩具沒有動。畫面要清楚表現乾電池放錯邊，但電池盒、玩具、電池上不可有文字、正負號、數字、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩的褲子被水弄濕，主角媽媽提醒她先換乾的褲子；旁邊可有乾的褲子放在椅子上。畫面只呈現提醒和準備換的安全情境，不呈現更衣過程；不可有文字、數字或標籤。
